items.rationale: Surge damage by lightning overvoltage is covered under 2.3.3 and the endorsement waives the 50% reduction. Replacement at standard grade (7.1.9) within the EUR 5,000 sub-limit. In Case 1 the unreduced pair came to about 1,600-1,800 gross, so I put the speakers at about 750.
Carriage and delivery of replacement property is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b), so t = 0.
Fitting and commissioning of replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).

The TV was damaged by the surge, so it is covered under 2.3.3. The surge-protection endorsement waives the 50% reduction. Indemnity is a standard-grade equivalent replacement within the sub-limit, estimated from Case 1 at about 850.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics (arrangement)
items.rationale: This charge arises from a property and liability arrangement, which is excluded under 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
The charge for placing an order under a service arrangement is excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
The attendance charge is on an invoice whose work is not indemnifiable, so 7.1.8(d) excludes it. Case 1 shows a very low threshold for this kind of line.
